messages:
Alex: Heads up — noticed invoice preview diffs after yesterday's routing change. For a subset of tenants (mostly EU/PROD-WEST) token counts jumped ~0.5-2% vs shadow. Anyone else seeing this?
Maria: saw same. dashboard card shows bump around 03:15 UTC. Appears correlated with redispatch spikes when route fallback happens. :eyes:
Sam: Confirming. Tracing shows duplicate metering events: same original user request but two billing events emitted with different route_tag. Consumer dedupe didn't catch because fingerprint includes route_tag.
Julien: That matches the codepath — we intentionally include route_tag so we can bill variant-specific rates. But the fallback case should not emit a second bill, just re-route.
Alex: My hunch: edge redispatch is creating a new request_id when it retries across regions instead of preserving the original id. Quick mitigation: preserve `x-original-request-id` header through redispatch.
Maria: Alternative: include an explicit `idempotency_key` in the billing payload so downstream can dedupe regardless of route_tag. That would be backward-compatible for the ledger.
Sam: idempotency_key helps, but note our ingest-side dedupe window is 2m. Some duplicates arrive >2m later due to reingest/backpressure, so we still see invoice preview deltas. We need both: preserve id + extend dedupe window for flagged replays.
ingest-bot: alert: invoice_preview_delta > 0.3% for 27 tenants in prod-west (see incident #INC-2026-112) :rotating_light:
Julien: Proposal — short term: edge change to carry original id + add a `billing_id` to events (string). Long term: move route_tag out of fingerprint and record variant as an attribute so duplicates across variants don't double-bill.
Alex: Rollout plan: canary edge change (5% traffic) + tenant feature flag `billing-sensitivity` so we can opt-in critical tenants. Console UX needs a per-tenant preview metric and a clear explanation.
Maria: I'll open a console PR to add a "Billing preview toggle" and microcopy explaining the canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4123 — adding a per-tenant card with "invoice delta" and a link to the metering dashboard.
Sam: I'll add a dashboard card for immediate visibility: query idea — `sum(rate(metering.events{duplicate="true"}[5m])) / sum(rate(metering.events[5m]))` as a percent. Put an alert at 0.25% sustained for 30m.
Julien: For immediate cleanup: run a backfill-dedupe job that tags historical duplicates and adjusts invoice preview numbers. This touches ledger materialized views — needs Finance sign-off.
Alex: Who's the right approver to run a ledger backfill? @FinanceLead?
FinanceLead: I can approve but require a dry-run/simulate step and a complete audit log. No blind writes. If the simulation matches and we keep an immutable audit, I approve a one-time corrective pass. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Great. Maria — can you run a simulation against last 48h and post the results here by EOD? Sam — coordinate with infra to gate the canary and extend the ingest dedupe window for flagged tenants to 10m during canary.
Maria: Yup, starting the sim now. Will post a CSV & sample diffs.
Sam: infra contact tagged. I added the canary playbook steps to the PR. Also adding a smoke query to ensure no invoice delta spike after canary flip.
Julien: After canary, we should open a follow-up RFC: fingerprint semantics + dedupe guarantees across retries/redispatch. This keeps behavior consistent across Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
Alex: +1. Thanks everyone. Please react with :thumbsup: when you finish your action items so we can close the loop.
